def add_notes_to_instrument(instrument, notes, start_time, duration, gap=NOTE_GAP):
    """
    Add a sequence of single notes (or chords as lists) to an instrument.

    Parameters:
        instrument: pretty_midi.Instrument
        notes: list of ints (single notes) or lists of ints (chords).
               Use None or 0 for rests.
        start_time: float, start time of the first note in seconds
        duration: float, duration of each note/chord in seconds
        gap: float, small gap subtracted from duration to avoid overlaps
    """
    t = start_time
    for note in notes:
        if note is None or note == 0:
            # Rest — just advance time
            t += duration
            continue
        if isinstance(note, list):
            # Chord — add all pitches simultaneously
            for pitch in note:
                midi_note = pretty_midi.Note(
                    velocity=80, pitch=pitch,
                    start=t, end=t + duration - gap
                )
                instrument.notes.append(midi_note)
        else:
            # Single note
            midi_note = pretty_midi.Note(
                velocity=90, pitch=note,
                start=t, end=t + duration - gap
            )
            instrument.notes.append(midi_note)

"""
Generate six MIDI files for major-to-minor motif transformations.
Each file has three tracks:
  Track 1: Melody (RH) - eighth notes
  Track 2: LH broken arpeggio - eighth notes
  Track 3: LH blocked chords - half notes

import pretty_midi

TEMPO_BPM = 80
EIGHTH = 60.0 / TEMPO_BPM / 2
NOTE_GAP = 0.01
PIANO = 0


def add_single_notes(inst, notes, t0, dur, vel):
    t = t0
    for n in notes:
        if n is not None:
            inst.notes.append(pretty_midi.Note(vel, n, t, t + dur - NOTE_GAP))
        t += dur


def add_block_chords(inst, chords, t0, vel):
    t = t0
    for pitches, eighths in chords:
        d = EIGHTH * eighths
        if pitches is not None:
            for p in pitches:
                inst.notes.append(pretty_midi.Note(vel, p, t, t + d - NOTE_GAP))
        t += d

    pm = pretty_midi.PrettyMIDI(initial_tempo=TEMPO_BPM)
    t1 = pretty_midi.Instrument(program=PIANO, name="Melody RH")
    add_single_notes(t1, mel, 0.0, EIGHTH, 90)
    pm.instruments.append(t1)
    t2 = pretty_midi.Instrument(program=PIANO, name="LH Broken Arpeggio")
    add_single_notes(t2, arp, 0.0, EIGHTH, 70)
    pm.instruments.append(t2)
    t3 = pretty_midi.Instrument(program=PIANO, name="LH Blocked Chords")
    add_block_chords(t3, blk, 0.0, 65)

    ac = sum(1 for x in arp if x is not None)
    dur = len(mel) * EIGHTH
    print(f"Wrote {name}: 3 tracks, {mc} melody notes, {ac} arp notes, "
